theorem ideal_factorization_frozen_signature (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ 0) :
    ∃! f : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℕ, I = ∏ v ∈ f.support, v.asIdeal ^ f v := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, huniq⟩ := ideal_finsupp_factorization_existsUnique (K := K) I hI
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show I = ∏ v ∈ f.support, v.asIdeal ^ f v
    rw [← hf, Finsupp.prod]
  · intro f' hf'
    have hf'' : I = ∏ v ∈ f'.support, v.asIdeal ^ f' v := hf'
    exact huniq f' (by
      show (f'.prod fun v n => v.asIdeal ^ n) = I
      rw [Finsupp.prod, ← hf''])
